hero.headline: Support the
hero.subtext: Your support helps keep SmarTok's infrastructure running and keeps the platform available for high-value, educational content. Contributions are strictly for platform support and do not provide access to additional features, subscriptions, badges, or digital content within SmarTok.

contribution.disclaimer: Contributions are for platform infrastructure support only and do not grant access to any features, subscriptions, badges, or digital content within SmarTok.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.subtitle: We believe in complete openness. Every contribution and every expense is tracked and published here.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to SmarTok. By using our platform, you agree to the following terms and conditions.

sections.1_body: SmarTok is a platform designed for high-value, educational content. Our services are provided to users free of charge, supported by voluntary contributions to our infrastructure fund.
sections.2_body: All contributions made through the Support SmarTok page are strictly for platform infrastructure support. Contributions do not grant access to any additional features, subscriptions, badges, or digital content within SmarTok.
sections.3_body: Users are expected to engage respectfully and constructively. Content that violates our community guidelines may be removed, and accounts may be suspended at our discretion.
sections.4_body: All content published on SmarTok remains the property of its respective creators. Users retain ownership of their content and grant SmarTok a license to display it on the platform.
sections.5_body: We respect your privacy. Our privacy policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
sections.6_body: SmarTok is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any damages arising from the use of our platform.
sections.7_body: We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
